notes:
OCRelay 1.1.1

THREE NEW STUDIES

• Venous Mapping now has an Upper Extremity option — basilic and cephalic diameters for preoperative access mapping, with a warning if the worksheet has both arms measured.

• Liver Elastography — EQI stiffness values, with METAVIR staging shown as an advisory on both the GE and Philips scales and an IQR/Median quality note.

• OB Ultrasound gained a 2nd/3rd Trimester (Limited) option, including cervical length.

CAROTID — PLEASE READ

• The stenosis estimate now uses the SRU 2003 criteria printed on the worksheet (ICA PSV 125 cm/s). It previously used a later revision with a 180 threshold, which graded velocities between 125 and 180 one category too low.

• The ICA stenosis grade is now proposed into the report's pick list and can be edited in the review panel before sending. The CCA lines and the IMPRESSION are never written.

• A new cross-check compares the written ICA/CCA ratio against the measured velocities, and an unusual worksheet column order raises a warning.

FEWER MISSED VALUES

• The review panel reads the open PS360 report before you send and names any value that has no matching line, so a wrong-template mismatch is caught before the paste.

• After a fill, the result reports against everything that was read. A partial fill used to show "8/8 confirmed" in green while values were silently dropped.

• Implausible values are highlighted — a slipped decimal (26.5 read as 265) is flagged before it reaches the report.

UPDATES

• Settings now has a Check for Updates button that says why a check failed instead of failing silently. Failed checks are also written to the log.

• When a new template loads in PS360, the Study picker switches to match it. Turn this off under Settings → Studies.

• Settings → Tools → Accuracy Report shows how often each field needed correcting. Entirely local — nothing is sent anywhere.

FIXES

• Pasted values are no longer bold in PS360.

• Recall Last restores the worksheet warning banners, not just the measurements.

• The PS360 template watch no longer stops after the first review of a session.

• First run on a multi-monitor workstation no longer captures the wrong screen.
